statuses.native: The upstream behavior is exposed through the pinned Kimi protocol
statuses.secured: The behavior is preserved with an additional AIALRA security gate
statuses.substituted: The unsafe or host-GUI behavior has a browser-safe equivalent

features.evidence: ConversationTimeline.tsx renders official transcript turns, parts, offsets, and states
Official thinking, step, tool, retry, task, subagent, and compaction parts are rendered without inference
Completed prior turns fold intermediate parts while user input and final output remain visible
The host sidebar and session header expose the supported upstream lifecycle
The default remote action is recoverable archive
features.securityRationale: Permanent deletion is intentionally unavailable until step-up authentication and item-by-item confirmation are present

features.evidence: Stable prompt IDs and transcript cursors prevent duplicate submission and duplicate rendering
The composer exposes queued prompts, steering, and cancellation
The composer provides pinned built-ins plus host-discovered commands and skills
Unsupported host-GUI commands return a visible reason
features.securityRationale: Remote sessions never launch arbitrary applications on the execution host

features.evidence: At-sign completion and the workspace panel use host-scoped file RPC
The composer uploads attachments and transcript parts use bounded media reads
MarkdownRenderer.tsx handles prose, links, tables, fenced code, and media
Structured interactions are rendered from the current host snapshot
The activity panel and composer expose tasks and Plan mode
Context usage, model, thinking level, and permission controls reflect host state
The activity panel renders host-reported Git changes
Session commands call dedicated upstream endpoints
Approved host capabilities can be discovered and activated
features.securityRationale: Arbitrary plugin installation and provider-secret mutation remain local-only

features.evidence: Exports stream through the encrypted channel with a fixed size limit
features.securityRationale: Export content is never persisted by the control plane

features.evidence: Account state and every upstream usage window are read on the selected host
The browser terminal uses a host-bound encrypted relay
features.securityRationale: Terminal frames are bounded, audited by category, and never stored by the control plane

features.evidence: Elevation uses a separate broker and short-lived authorization
features.securityRationale: Elevation requires step-up authentication and terminates on disconnect or timeout

features.evidence: Browser reconnect preserves the selected host, session, transcript, and fold state
Every session reference and grant is bound to a host ID
features.securityRationale: Identical upstream session IDs on different hosts cannot share authorization or state
